compound.label: Plus-que-parfait
compound.why: had already happened before something else

links: Futur and Conditionnel share the stem débarrasser-. Learn one and you have both.
The Imparfait stem débarrass- is the nous form of the Présent (débarrassons) with -ons removed.
The Subjonctif stem débarrass- is the ils form of the Présent (débarrassent) with -ent removed.
The Impératif is the Présent with the pronoun dropped.

en: to leave something behind by accident
